advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Jesus the homeless hippy: Chris Olave for Jonathan Taylor.

reasons: You're 7-2 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 15%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 10 contenders (148.3 points a week).
Your weakest position is RB (5th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 2nd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 3rd in 2028 (title chances about 15%, 18%, 20%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 15% to 17%, and your lineup comes out 1.4 points a week ahead overall. Chris Olave adds 2.7 points a week for you today, but Jonathan Taylor is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 4,762, get 4,451), though it costs their lineup 1.3 a week, so expect some pushback.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 18% and 20% to 19% and 19%.
You have 4 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Week 14 is your weakest projected week (158 points vs your usual 182), mostly byes.
Rhamondre Stevenson may be worth more now than later: age 28: RB values usually drop after this season.
Jayden Daniels's trade value has dropped 19% in 24 days.
Lamar Jackson's trade value has dropped 28% in 24 days.
Tee Higgins's trade value has dropped 12% in 24 days.
advice.key: ["trade", "Make a trade", ["Offer Jesus the homeless hippy: Chris Olave for Jonathan Taylor."]]
